title: Grouping by the calculation group's column applies each item to the measure
query: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS ( Adjust[Adjustment], "v", [Total] ) ORDER BY Adjust[Adjustment]

source.quote: The calculation item is applied when you select the calculation item in a filter or slicer, or use it to group the values in a visual.
source.supports: each group of the column has one item in the filter context, which is applied to [Total]

derivation: Current: 60. Only Total x10: 60 * 10 = 600. Plus 2: 62. ORDER BY sorts the names as text: Current, Only Total x10, Plus 2.
notes: ORDER BY here is on the column's values as text. A model may sort a calculation group column by ordinal; the corpus model sets none.
